'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Kazakh protests]]
**The death toll from the protests in [[Kazakhstan]] increases to 164, including 103 who were killed in [[Almaty]]. 5,135 people have also been detained. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/9/more-than-5000-arrested-since-riots-erupted-a-week-ago (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[79th Golden Globe Awards]]
**South Korean actor [[O Yeong-su (actor)|O Yeong-su]] wins the [[Golden Globe Awards|Golden Globe Award]] for [[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Series, Miniseries or Television Film|Best Supporting Actor]] in the ''[[Squid Game]]'' television series, becoming the first person from [[South Korea]] to win the honor. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/art/2022/01/688_322024.html (''Korea Times'')]
**[[Mj Rodriguez]] wins the [[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Television Series Drama|Best Actress]] in the ''[[Pose (TV series)|Pose]]'' television series, becoming the first trans actress to win a Golden Globe. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/01/10/entertainment/michaela-jae-rodriguez-golden-globes-cec/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Bronx apartment fire]]
**Seventeen people are killed and 44 others are injured after a fire spreads through a 19-story apartment building in [[the Bronx]], [[New York City]], United States. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/01/09/us/bronx-fire-injuries/index.html (CNN)] [https://abcnews.go.com/US/dozens-injured-alarm-fire-york-city-apartment-building/story?id=82164322 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[Tianjin]] begins city-wide [[COVID-19 testing]] for 14 million people after 20 children and adults tested positive for [[COVID-19]], two of whom were infected with the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/09/chinese-city-of-tianjin-to-test-14-million-people-after-covid-outbreak (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kuwait]]
****[[Kuwait]] reports a record 2,999 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 433,919. [https://www.kuna.net.kw/ArticleDetails.aspx?id=3020455&language=en (Kuwait News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kyrgyzstan]]
****[[Ministry of Health (Kyrgyzstan)|Health Minister]] Alymkadyr Beishenaliev announces that 55% of the [[Kyrgyzstan]] population has received their first doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://akipress.com/news:666819:55__of_eligible_population_in_Kyrgyzstan_receive_at_least_one_dose_of_COVID-19_vaccine/ (AKIPress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 28,707 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,965,447. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/coronavirus-cases-philippines-january-9-2022/ (Rappler)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Qatar]]
****[[Qatar]] reports a record 3,487 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 266,344. [https://www.qatar-tribune.com/latestnews-article/mid/506/articleid/8305/qatar-records-3-487-new-covid-19-cases (''Qatar Tribune'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports a record 16 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the statewide death toll to 727. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-01-09/nsw-records-30062-covid-cases-16-deaths/100746206 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Greece]]
***The [[Greece|Greek]] [[Government of Greece|government]] announces that fully vaccinated people who have not received a COVID-19 vaccine [[booster dose]] seven months after receiving their second dose will be banned from entering most indoor venues and participating in many types of activities beginning on February 1. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/greece-sets-february-deadline-for-booster-jabs.926623.amp (''Times of Malta'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***The total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases in [[Africa]] surpasses 10 million. [https://www.barrons.com/news/total-covid-cases-in-africa-top-10-million-watchdog-01641717306?refsec=afp-news (''Barron's'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Mali]]
**The [[West Africa]]n nations of the 15-member bloc [[Economic Community of West African States|ECOWAS]] suspend diplomatic relations with [[Mali]] and announce that they are closing their borders with and imposing economic sanctions on Mali in response to an "unacceptable delay" to the country's [[Next Malian general election|next general election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mali-eyes-elections-four-years-west-african-bloc-mulls-sanctions-2022-01-09/ (Reuters)]
